material_class.structural_family: μ6-Cl-centered La6 trigonal prism alkoxo cluster

synthesis.procedure: All operations were performed in a dry box under nitrogen or argon with anhydrous solvents. Metallic lanthanum chips (3 g, 21 mmol) and iPrOH (20 mL) were boiled under reflux for several days in the presence of a HgCl2/HgI2/Hg(OAc)2 catalyst mixture. After boiling, transparent shiny needles of complex I crystallized from the solutions. The mother liquor concentrated under vacuum gave amorphous powder II, distinct from I.
